coverage_note: This page primarily contains detailed material, dimensional, and type-testing specifications for vent outlet automatic closing devices, air pipe heads, and floats in marine piping systems. Most content consists of test procedures, acceptance criteria, and manufacturing tolerances which do not map to the allowed pump-system relationship types. Only three relations were extracted: a containment relation for the air pipe head chambers, an inspection relation linking the air pipe head to its type testing action, and an operating condition for maximum allowable leakage. The extensive test protocols (impact, compression, tightness, reverse flow) are represented as unrepresented source because they are procedural specifications rather than maintainable/operational relationships between pump system entities.
